author: Aniket Ashokbhai Domadiya
short_description: An offline agentic pipeline that profiles classification datasets, generates a conditional plan, trains candidate models, evaluates and reflects to propose replans. Designed for deterministic rule-based reasoning and meta-learning via a JSON-backed memory.

key_claims.claim_short: Agent profiles dataset and detects scenario signals
key_claims.why_it_proves: profile_dataset produces a structured profile consumed by create_plan which emits a scenario-tagged plan; unit tests verify expected scenario selection.

key_claims.claim_short: Agent trains and selects best model and computes evaluation artefacts
key_claims.why_it_proves: train_models returns best/all metrics; evaluate_best creates confusion matrix and report strings; tests exercise both functions end-to-end on a small dataset.

key_claims.claim_short: Agent reflects, diagnoses root causes and recommends replans
key_claims.why_it_proves: reflect synthesises statistics and model metrics to produce structured reflection with root_cause and replan_recommended; tests cover core reflection heuristics and replan application.

key_claims.claim_short: Agent learns meta-learning signals in persistent memory
key_claims.why_it_proves: JSONMemory persists reflection history and returns hints/effectiveness used by planner and reflector; tests validate storage and hint retrieval.

limitations_and_known_issues: No LLMs used; decision logic is rule-based and may not handle entirely novel failure modes.
Windows console encoding can expose unicode print issues (workaround applied in log()).
Some heavy training options (large datasets) are disabled/guarded in code; tests use small synthetic data.

reproducibility_notes.deterministic_flags: model random_state set where applicable; training may still be non-deterministic across platforms for some estimators
reproducibility_notes.expected_runtime: A few minutes for demo; tests run in ~1 minute locally

notes: This COHERENCE.json maps claims to concrete evidence in the repository so an assessor can quickly verify reasoning vs implementation. Update registration_number and coverage_percent before submission.
